flows.label: One feature · controller-owned task references and checkpoints
Saved scope · acceptance evidence · complete outline review
Automated pass · manual acceptance still needed
Evidence-ready plan · scenario and checkpoint review
Feature planning · saved acceptance batches before tasks
Feature-by-feature · scope context and explicit output reservation
Known API contracts · bound unapproved prefix memory
Static interfaces · actual builder constraints · approved task boundary
Focused Ollama task · native scoped JSON
Task readiness · approval, dependencies and source identity
Repair · source-bound attempt and later validation
